quests.title: Four Names
quests.summary: Learn where Tristan's families came from, from the Glasses, Greens, Repettos and Rogers, then take the Chief Islander's challenge.

steps.text: Hear the Glass story: a Scottish corporal from Kelso.
Hear the Green story: a Dutch sailor who settled in the 1830s.
Hear the Repetto story: two Italian sailors from Camogli.
Hear the Rogers story: an American whaler, then return to the Chief Islander for a battle.

quests.reward: The Tristan Hat (a Frost charm), three Tristan Potatoes and standing in the Overseas Territories.
